concepts.definition: An engagement frame is a frame whose evaluation family concerns selecting, constructing, assessing or disposing governed work. Executive, Worker and Reviewer are this profile's engagement frames.

An engagement frame is a frame (REFERENCE_FRAME §1) whose evaluation family

concepts.label: Engagement frame

concepts.definition: A specialist frame is an activated Product, requirement, design, identity, release, domain, implementation, test, operational, historical or capability frame needed by one engagement evaluation.

grounding.quote:
A specialist frame is an activated Product, requirement, design, identity,
release, domain, implementation, test, operational, historical or

concepts.label: Specialist frame

concepts.definition: A generic specialist-frame family is a reusable evaluation archetype naming a recurring distinction. It selects no concrete carrier, component, actor, architecture, owner or implementation. Its labels resolve in urn:stdo:bounded-context:reference-frame-evaluation, owned by REFERENCE_FRAME under the selected basis; same-spelled concepts in other contexts are not thereby identical.

grounding.quote:
A generic specialist-frame family is a reusable evaluation-family archetype
of this profile (§11). It names a recurring distinction that a project
either instantiates where material, has capable authority establish as
non-material for the governed outcome, or keeps as an explicit coverage
residual (P2, P6; rc.2 #generic-specialist-frame-family).

The family labels resolve inside
`urn:stdo:bounded-context:reference-frame-evaluation`, owned by
REFERENCE_FRAME, under the selected basis. Under bounded-context semantic
resolution (PRODUCT_DEFINITION §5), `Product`, `Owner`, `Entity`,
`Operator`, `Install` and the other labels do not become equal to
same-spelled Product, authority, domain or runtime concepts; every material
cross-context seam needs an explicit relation (P1, P3).

concepts.label: Generic specialist-frame family

concepts.definition: Testing frame, authoritative Product path and material combinatorial complexity are tier-2 terms owned and defined by ASSURANCE §7. This profile uses those definitions without additions.

grounding.quote:
Testing frame, authoritative Product path and material combinatorial
complexity are tier-2 terms defined in ASSURANCE §7. This profile uses them

concepts.definition: Executive labels the engagement frame that selects or confirms bounded activation configuration and consumes closed Worker and Reviewer results under existing project decision authority. It holds the complete Product view and current MVP or release mandate needed for priority, disposition and the next authorised action, without containing the complete workspace or becoming a universal semantic owner, controller, manager service or runtime observer.

grounding.quote:
Executive is this profile's label for the frame that selects or confirms
the bounded activation configuration and consumes closed Worker and
Reviewer results under existing project decision authority. It holds the
complete Product view and the current MVP or release mandate needed to
assign priority, apply disposition and select the next authorised action
(P6, P2; rc.2 #executive).

concepts.label: Executive

concepts.definition: Worker labels the constructor role of ACTIVATION §1 activated as a frame. It owns bounded construction and self-review within exact intake through operation authority inherited from the governing work relation. Writer specialises this role for documents and records.

grounding.quote:
Worker is this profile's label for the constructor role of ACTIVATION §1
activated as a frame. It owns construction and self-review inside its exact
intake, through the operation authority inherited from the governing work
relation. It acquires no admission, publication, acceptance or continuation
authority (P6; rc.2 #worker).

concepts.label: Worker / Writer

concepts.definition: Reviewer labels independently activated live-surface evaluation consumed by the assessment relation. It evaluates one exact subject and returns a closed result with evidence-bound technical triage when a finding exists, subject to externally owned independence, traceability, assurance-boundary and qualification-freeze rules.

grounding.quote:
Reviewer is this profile's label for the independent live-surface
evaluation that the assessment relation of ACTIVATION §1 consumes, governed
by EVALUATION §3 (independence and traceability) and EVALUATION §1 and §7
(assurance boundary and qualification freeze), activated as a frame. It
evaluates one exact subject and returns a closed result, with evidence-bound
technical triage when a finding exists.

concepts.label: Reviewer

concepts.definition: Technical triage assesses one finding against its exact evaluated claim and basis. Severity grades the consequence if the finding manifests. Priority orders response relative to the complete Product outcome, likelihood, exposure, current MVP or release mandate, reversibility, dependencies, delay cost and available capacity. The Reviewer grades severity; the Executive assigns priority.

grounding.quote:
Severity grades the consequence if the finding manifests. Priority orders
the response relative to the complete Product outcome, likelihood and
exposure, the current MVP or release mandate, reversibility, dependencies,
cost of delay and available capacity. The Reviewer grades severity; the
Executive assigns priority (P6, P2).

concepts.label: Technical triage, severity and priority

concepts.definition: Current-boundary effect is the Executive's recorded determination that one finding blocks the current promotion boundary, requires narrowing it, or may remain an explicit residual. It is a decision projection, distinct from severity, priority, frame result and disposition, with no independent core-value mapping or decision power.

grounding.quote:
Current-boundary effect is the Executive's recorded determination of what
one finding does to the current promotion boundary: it blocks it, requires
narrowing it, or may remain an explicit residual. It is a decision
projection, a state this profile declares, not a result and not a
disposition (§8): it maps to no core value of its own and decides nothing
by itself.

concepts.label: Current-boundary effect

conditions: A lawful Worker activation has occurred.
concepts.definition: A work result is the Worker's closed output to its declared consumer, the Executive in the coordinated branch. Its five construction-availability values refine the predicate 'a candidate is available', with total, exclusive mappings owned by ACTIVATION §3: candidate_ready→satisfied; refused→falsified; incomplete→falsified; re_entry_requested(authority)→out_of_frame; re_entry_requested(basis)→invalid_basis. These are carriers, not new dispositions, assessment or acceptance.
exceptions: Activation refusal produces no Worker activation, evaluation or work result.

grounding.quote:
The work-result values are the five values of construction availability,
the refinement that
[ACTIVATION §3](ACTIVATION.md#construction-availability) defines for the
predicate "a candidate is available". ACTIVATION §3 owns their grounds,
maps each to exactly one core value, and states that the mapping is total
and exclusive after lawful activation. In this profile they are carriers,
not new semantic dispositions, and none of them is an assessment or an
acceptance of the candidate (FOUNDATIONS §4 Results).

- `re_entry_requested(authority)` (`out_of_frame`): the Executive returns
  the question to the decision owner the value names; and
- `re_entry_requested(basis)` (`invalid_basis`): the Executive revalidates
  the basis lock (§6 Drift locks) before any further activation.

concepts.label: Work result and construction availability

grounding.quote:
An exact candidate is the subject identity that the transition evidence of
ACTIVATION §7 and the traceability of EVALUATION §3 require.

concepts.label: Exact candidate

Goals, Product, requirements, accepted design, a ticket, release law or an

concepts.label: Product-owned Project Reference-Frame Basis

A baseline-adoption projection consumes the Product-owned Project

concepts.label: Baseline-adoption projection

conditions: The configuration is selected where construction of bounded changes and delivery across tasks need separate attention.
concepts.definition: The executive configuration allocates construction to Worker/Writer, required assessment to Reviewer, and coordination and bounded disposition to Executive. It is one lawful configuration selected for task fit, not the method default or a roster all work requires.

while U is non-empty:

concepts.label: Attention cycle

concepts.definition: The five drift locks concern unchanged outcome and mandate; exact current basis coordinates; distinct Product-chain roles; unchanged authority owners and grants; and complete material coverage plus declared result-return relations. They are checked before activation and disposition.

grounding.quote:
Before activation and before disposition, the Executive revalidates five
locks (P3, P6, P2; rc.2 #executive-drift-locks):

concepts.label: Drift locks

concepts.definition: A Product-chain basis records one Product or an explicit directed chain, preserving each mutable Source Project, current Product Definition, exact candidate checkpoint, Release Cut, Product, Install, Artifact, Development Product, dependent Product and composition-edge role as distinct. Each Development Product role binds one exact underlying Install.

grounding.quote:
A governed outcome may concern one Product or an explicit directed chain of
Products. Its basis records the distinct role of every mutable Source
Project, current Product Definition, exact candidate checkpoint, Release
Cut, Product, Install, Artifact, Development Product, dependent Product and
composition edge. Each Development Product role binds one exact underlying

concepts.label: Product-chain basis

concepts.definition: Authority precedence decides which existing surface may select work, admit configurations, dispose results or require re-entry. Temporal and evidence flow carries activation packets and closed results. Frame topology records disjointness, overlap, conjunction, translation or composition; evaluation independence and Reviewer assurance independence remain separate activation relations. These structures may align where warranted but are never one hierarchy.

1. authority precedence, RF-009's structure of that name, decides which
   existing surface may select work, admit a frame configuration, dispose
   a result or require re-entry;
2. temporal and evidence flow, RF-009's communication, carries activation
   packets and closed results; and
3. frame topology records disjointness, overlap, conjunction, translation

concepts.label: Distinct configuration relation structures

concepts.definition: A steel thread is the smallest real runnable path from a supported Product entry through selected composition to a material outcome. This profile selects early establishment and bounded widening, or extension/revalidation of an existing affected thread, for early composition feedback at the cost of later widening.

grounding.quote:
The Executive sequences delivery around a steel thread: the smallest real,
runnable path from a supported Product entry to a material outcome through
the selected composition. The path is established early and widened in
bounded increments; where it already exists, the affected thread is extended
or revalidated. Increments are chosen for consequential uncertainty,
dependency and interface reach, and failure impact (P2; rc.2
#steel-thread-delivery; the generic sequencing heuristic is SPEC_METHOD §8).

concepts.label: Steel-thread delivery

concepts.definition: Product archetype: evaluate one exact current Product claim, outcome, boundary and lifecycle against current Intent, Product, requirements, acceptance meaning and coordinates. Product and requirement authority retain meaning and acceptance; output is bounded evaluation and evidence only. Immediate falsifier: design, code, tests, predecessor behaviour or local convention changes Product meaning or substitutes another subject.

grounding.quote: | Product | Does one exact current Product claim, outcome, boundary and lifecycle govern the claimed Product subject without downstream reinterpretation? The basis is the current Intent, Product, requirements, acceptance meaning and exact Product coordinates. | Product and requirement authority keep meaning and acceptance. The frame returns only a bounded evaluation result and evidence. | Design, code, tests, a predecessor's behaviour or a local convention changes Product meaning or substitutes another Product subject. |

concepts.label: Product evaluation family

concepts.definition: Product Composition archetype: evaluate one exact directed inter-Product relation preserving source/target roles, Product Definition, Release Cut, Product and Install identities, Development Product bindings, contracts, authority, lifecycle, evidence boundary and invalidation law. Chains use bounded edge activations and declared conjunction. Each Product retains meaning; cited authority/contracts own the edge; output is evaluation evidence only. Immediate falsifiers include inferred composition from nesting, shared implementation/actor, imports, tool reachability, matching output or builder convenience; confusing builder and authored Product; or silent inter-node redefinition.

grounding.quote: A chain is evaluated through bounded edge activations and a declared conjunction.

concepts.label: Product Composition evaluation family

concepts.definition: Design archetype: evaluate whether accepted structural HOW satisfies material constitutional WHAT, closes required design relations and preserves owners across affected topology. Accepted design under governing Product and requirements owns structural decisions. Permitted findings are satisfaction, contradiction or design re-entry gaps, never invented Product truth. Immediate falsifiers are implementation precedent resolving open material design, design creating Product meaning, or undeclared material relations or competing structures.

grounding.quote: The frame may identify satisfaction, contradiction or a design re-entry gap; it cannot invent Product truth.

concepts.label: Design evaluation family

concepts.definition: Design Component archetype: evaluate a bounded component and direct causal dependency cone for parent-contract, internal-relation, sibling-seam and required-output preservation. The accepted design boundary owns only its bounded composition decision; parent, sibling, Product, requirement and runtime owners retain theirs. Immediate falsifiers are omitted material far-side seams, absorbed sibling/parent decisions, or local closure despite unresolved direct composition.

grounding.quote: The component omits a material far-side seam, absorbs a sibling or parent decision, or reports local closure while its direct composition is unresolved.

concepts.label: Design Component evaluation family

concepts.definition: Public Boundary archetype: evaluate one supported public entry/exit for exactly assigned validation, selection, transport, refusal and projection while preserving interior owners. Product, interface, identity, security and accepted-design authority define it. Output is a closed boundary evaluation/result or refusal, without recreating interior semantics. Immediate falsifiers are interpreting owner meaning, sequencing hidden domain decisions, exposing interior carriers as Product truth or admitting unsupported paths.

grounding.quote: The frame evaluates the boundary result or refusal and returns only its closed evaluation; it does not recreate interior semantics.

concepts.label: Public Boundary evaluation family

concepts.definition: Entity archetype: evaluate one semantic, artifact or runtime entity's exact identity, kind, lifecycle, owner, representation and applicable effect regime. Product, domain, identity, requirement and accepted-design authority define it; output is identity- and lifecycle-bound evaluation. Immediate falsifiers are substituting filenames, wrappers, tickets, shapes, caches or process instances for stable identity, or collapsing lifecycle coordinates.

grounding.quote: A filename, wrapper, ticket, object shape, cache or process instance stands in for stable entity identity, or distinct lifecycle coordinates are collapsed.

concepts.label: Entity evaluation family

concepts.definition: Operator archetype: evaluate one material operation as an irreducible declared relation over admitted domain, inputs, outputs, refusals, algebra, effects and lawful compositions. Product, requirements, accepted ontology/design and named operation owner define it. Evaluation creates no additional executable plan. Immediate falsifiers are treating endpoint/function/class/command/file labels as semantic atoms, hiding the operator in orchestration, or rebuilding generic mechanics as domain law.

grounding.quote: The frame evaluates it without creating another executable plan.

concepts.label: Operator evaluation family

concepts.definition: Owner archetype: evaluate preservation of a semantic or authority-bearing relation's owner, role kind, subject, scope, basis, lifecycle, refusal invariants and permitted delegation. Existing named Product, requirement, identity, accepted-design, release or other authority owns it; output evaluates authority congruence only. Immediate falsifiers are recreated judgment, authorship treated as authority transfer, or widening grants by proxy, foundation, frame or actor.

grounding.quote: The frame may evaluate authority congruence only.

concepts.label: Owner evaluation family

concepts.definition: Effect archetype: evaluate an action against its declared pure, observational, artifact or runtime effect regime, including material commit, failure, retry, recovery, compensation, admission and projection law. Applicable Product, requirement, design, artifact, runtime and admission owners retain decisions; output is effect-bound result and evidence. Immediate falsifiers are collapsed regimes, bypassed mutation owners, compensation treated as semantic rollback or reads becoming rival writable truth.

grounding.quote: Distinct effect regimes are collapsed, a mutation bypasses its admitted owner, compensation is treated as semantic rollback, or a read becomes rival writable truth.

concepts.label: Effect evaluation family

concepts.definition: Reuse/Foundation archetype: evaluate normalization and comparison of a material generic capability or dependency against credible lawful foundations while preserving irreducible local remainder and authority-bearing role. Design-profile selection law and existing trade-off owner govern selection; no semantic authority moves to a foundation. Immediate falsifiers are incumbent/local preference without bounded comparison, reproduction of richer lawful foundations, favorable scoring of unknowns or reuse acquiring owner authority.

grounding.quote: Incumbent or local code wins without a bounded comparison, a richer lawful foundation is reproduced, unknowns are scored favourably, or reuse acquires owner authority.

concepts.label: Reuse/Foundation evaluation family

concepts.definition: Install archetype: evaluate resolution and exercise of the exact selected Product, release, artifact, dependencies, configuration and callable entry through its admitted installed coordinate independently of mutable-source convenience. Product, identity, release, dependency, packaging and accepted-design authority define the subject; output is installed identity, reachability and refusal evidence. Immediate falsifiers are source imports, ambient resolution, registries, fixture bindings, rebuilt artifacts or moving workspaces standing in for the installed subject.

grounding.quote: The frame returns installed identity, reachability and refusal evidence.

concepts.label: Install evaluation family

concepts.definition: Proof archetype: evaluate one exact claim for congruent subject, basis, path, population, oracle, evidence, falsifier, residual boundary and invalidation law. The claim owner defines meaning; testing, assurance, review, Product and release owners define evaluation and acceptance. Output is evidence and closed evaluation, never Product meaning or disposition. Immediate falsifiers are harness-created owner meaning, mismatched subject/path, counts or aggregate green substituted for claims, or undetectable subject mutation by proof tools.

grounding.quote: The frame returns evidence and a closed evaluation result, not Product meaning or disposition.

concepts.label: Proof evaluation family

concepts.definition: Refinement is a declared evaluation dependency for material distinctions needed to close a parent evaluation, not an organisational or runtime hierarchy. Coverage is the union of admissible observations from activated frames. Composite claims take their declared conjunction; every material cross-frame seam is mandatory result or required coverage, and no frame is dominant.

grounding.quote:
Refinement opens only for a material
distinction needed to close the parent evaluation. It is a frame dependency
relation, not an organisational or runtime hierarchy (P2, P4a; ACTIVATION
§4).

concepts.label: Refinement, coverage and conjunction

conditions: The specialist set is adopted.
concepts.definition: ASSURANCE §7 product testing frames supply claim-congruent evidence to Proof evaluations while user-acceptance, end-to-end, integration and unit results keep distinct claims and coordinates. ASSURANCE §13's end-to-end interface integration frame connects Public Boundary, Design, Operator, Owner and Proof with integration, end-to-end and user-acceptance frames. Its computational whole-path evaluation composes selected interface claims with Operator, Owner, Reuse/Foundation and Proof.

grounding.quote:
The end-to-end interface integration frame (ASSURANCE §13) relates the
Public Boundary, Design, Operator, Owner and Proof families to the
integration, end-to-end and user-acceptance frames. Its computational
whole-path evaluation composes the selected interface claims with Operator,
Owner, Reuse/Foundation and Proof. Neither adds a thirteenth family, a fifth
testing type, a role or a universal activation gate (P2; rc.2
#derived-end-to-end-interface-integration-frame,
#computational-whole-path-evaluation).

concepts.label: Testing and interface evaluation relations

concepts.definition: Handoff projections are bounded records for Worker activation, activation refusal, work result, Reviewer activation, review result, specialist activation, specialist result, and disposition/checkpoint. They describe producer-consumer transfer through admitted carriers, without creating a new artifact type or implicit continuation.

grounding.quote:
The coordinated branch uses the following bounded projections. They may be
fields in existing Goals, tickets, design assets, commentary, qualification
or release evidence, or other admitted carriers; the profile requires no new
artifact type (P2, P6; rc.2 #handoff-projection).

concepts.label: Handoff projections

concepts.definition: A project-defined configuration may use different frames, names, overlaps, sequences and actor bindings while preserving every applicable method relation and explaining how its evaluations cover its claims. It is evaluated against task, dependencies, actor limits, authority and assurance, not resemblance to the baseline.

grounding.quote:
A project configuration need not keep the labels Executive, Worker and
Reviewer or map one local frame to each. It keeps every applicable method
relation and identifies how its evaluations cover the claims it makes. It
is evaluated against its task, its dependencies, its actors' limits, the
authority it applies and the required assurance, as ACTIVATION §1
Configuration states, never by its labels, its topology or its difference
from this profile. A local axioms document may carry the accepted
configuration; its authority is the cited Goals, Product, requirement or
accepted-design decision, not the document's category (P6, P1).

concepts.label: Project-defined configuration

grounding.quote: where it conflicts with an owning clause, that clause controls.

Three parts add no
rule of their own: §5 Terms owned by ASSURANCE uses the tier-2 terms as
ASSURANCE §7 defines them; this table is a trace; and §23 records
dispositions and decides nothing. The rows name pillars 1 to 9. No row
names pillar 10, axiomatic calculus: this profile states no rule of the
a_c calculus and binds none.

constraints.statement: The profile owns only added terms and choices; owning clauses control conflicts, inclusion in a method cut grants availability rather than adoption, and frame labels bind allocated responsibilities without creating authority. Imported rules retain their owners. Consumers apply owning rules and decide nothing additional. The foundation table is a trace, ASSURANCE terms add no rule, and source §23 dispositions decide nothing. The trace covers the lead and §§1–22 by its own stated accounting, cites pillars 1–9, binds no axiomatic-calculus rule, and is new with no rc.2 row. Its purpose is to distinguish foundational/imported consequences from profile and Product choices, not derive those choices from foundations.
constraints.uncertainty: The source's whole-member accounting is reported, not independently verified against unsupplied sections.

grounding.quote:
Repeated resets, long repair loops, moving review subjects, proof masking
and duplicated authority are generic signals that a frame declaration,
activation, capability match, basis or authority relation may be defective
(REFERENCE_FRAME §10, missing-frame signals). They justify re-evaluation;
they neither identify one universal architecture nor give a precedent
semantic authority (P6, P5).

constraints.statement: One bounded authority selects active work and finite evaluating frames. Worker constructs one exact candidate, self-reviews, reports and stops. Where independent assessment is required, a separately activated Reviewer acquires sufficient exact live authority, subject and evidence, reuses valid computed facts but supplies its own judgment, and returns evidence-bound severity and technical implications without becoming another implementation loop. Where coordination is required, Executive assigns priority and adjudicates the current Product mandate under an existing bounded grant. Failure to perceive a known violation is evidence of a missing, misactivated, oversized or capability-incompatible frame. Repeated resets, repair loops, moving subjects, proof masking, duplicated authority and Product drift justify re-evaluation of possible defects, not a verdict or universal architecture. Shared visibility or participation in a delivery chain does not turn an implementation, specialisation, scenario, dependency, installed builder or downstream Product into the authored Product.
constraints.uncertainty: Signals support diagnosis and re-evaluation; they do not uniquely identify a defect.

conditions: A method member, file, component or lens is claimed as a frame.

grounding.quote:
A method member,
file, component or lens becomes a frame only when its evaluation, basis,
material manifold, authority, evidence, result algebra and capability
envelope are declared (REFERENCE_FRAME §13, minimal frame declaration; P1,
P6; rc.2 #specialist-frame).

constraints.statement: Frame status requires declared evaluation, basis, material manifold, authority, evidence, result algebra and capability envelope; a member, file, component or lens alone is insufficient.

conditions: For each governed outcome and every family in its known evaluation inventory.

grounding.quote:
For each governed outcome the known evaluation inventory (REFERENCE_FRAME
§8) disposes every family as one of (P2, P6, P5):

- instantiated by one or more exact frame declarations or authoritative
  acquisition paths, because the family is material;
- evidenced as non-material to the exact outcome by the authority capable
  of that determination; or
- kept as an explicit uncovered, conditional, conflicted or `out_of_frame`
  residual.

constraints.statement: Every family must be instantiated through one or more exact declarations or authoritative acquisition paths because material, evidenced non-material by capable authority for the exact outcome, or retained as explicit uncovered, conditional, conflicted or out_of_frame residual. Missing files, components, runtime objects or actors are not evidence of non-materiality. Adoption requires neither twelve components nor twelve activations for every task.

conditions: A finding exists; each triage field is recorded where admissible evidence and the actor's capability envelope support it.

grounding.quote:
Missing causal or repair evidence stays explicit. Where the missing
relation can change the evaluation, the Reviewer returns `indeterminate` or
`out_of_frame` pressure (FOUNDATIONS §4 Results); it does not invent precision and
does not send work sideways to the Worker (P5).

constraints.statement: Triage records affected claim and observed failure; Product-scale severity; causal assessment and confidence as a quantified assurance claim; blast radius and affected users, paths or relations; available workaround or containment; repair complexity, regression risk and material dependencies; residual uncertainty and reducing evidence. Missing causal or repair support remains explicit. A missing relation capable of changing evaluation produces indeterminate or out_of_frame pressure, not invented precision or sideways work assignment to Worker.
constraints.uncertainty: The quantified-assurance rules and precise result grounds are externally owned and not fully supplied.

grounding.quote:
This profile imposes no
universal numeric scale. Severity, priority, the frame result
(FOUNDATIONS §4 Results) and the current-boundary effect are four distinct
values. When a finding can block a promotion boundary is
[EVALUATION §5 When a finding blocks promotion](EVALUATION.md#when-a-finding-blocks-promotion),
and none of the four values alone decides it (P6, P1).

constraints.statement: The Product-owned basis binds severity and priority scales, current-boundary cutoff and its non-waivable hard stops; this profile supplies no universal numeric scale. ACTIVATION §4 owns hard-stop meaning and typical, non-closed classes. Hard stops hold regardless of priority, cutoff or risk appetite; no decision waives them. Severity, priority, frame result and boundary effect remain distinct, and none alone decides blocking. A blocks projection requires an EVALUATION §5 condition; its decision reaches the core only through the one existing disposition. No field other than disposition decides acceptance. Lowering priority cannot waive a hard stop or falsified mandatory claim. An observation outside the exact claim cannot open another review round merely because its label is severe.
constraints.uncertainty: EVALUATION §5's complete blocking conditions are not supplied.

grounding.quote:
An `activation_refusal`, with the cause and
core value that
[REFERENCE_FRAME §5](REFERENCE_FRAME.md#5-method-functions) gives it,
returns to the assigning authority or declared result carrier and creates
neither a Worker activation nor a Worker result.

constraints.statement: Work results exist only after successful lawful activation. Known activation-time capability, authority, stale-basis, ambiguous-basis or topology mismatch is activation_refusal with its owned cause/core value, returned to assigning authority or declared result carrier, never a synthetic Worker result. ACTIVATION §3 owns availability grounds; the profile adds none. ACTIVATION §§1 and 3 retain execution, result and disposition ownership.
constraints.uncertainty: The full activation-refusal cause-to-core mapping is not supplied.

conditions: A lawful Worker result is consumed.

grounding.quote:
- `candidate_ready` (`satisfied`): the consumer receives the exact
  candidate and its transition evidence and decides whether independent
  review is required (§12 step 4); the value is not `accept`;
- `refused` (`falsified`): the work result names the prohibition or
  refusal that is the value's counterexample; the Executive verifies the
  basis and applies the existing authority relation (§12 step 4);
- `incomplete` (`falsified`): the Worker's residuals and stop basis name
  each evaluation it did not perform, which has no result, each it
  performed that its evidence could not decide, which keeps its own
  `indeterminate`, and whether bounded execution ended first. The work
  result is never read as `indeterminate`, as ACTIVATION §3 states, and
  the Executive reactivates work only where current authority already
  permits it (§12 step 4);

constraints.statement: candidate_ready carries exact candidate and transition evidence and prompts the consumer's review-requirement decision; it is not accept. refused names its prohibition/refusal counterexample, followed by basis verification and existing authority application. incomplete names every unperformed evaluation as having no result, every performed undecidable evaluation with its own indeterminate, and whether bounded execution ended first; the availability result itself remains falsified, never indeterminate. Reactivation requires current permission. Authority re-entry returns to the named decision owner; basis re-entry requires basis-lock revalidation before any further activation. Existing carriers retain computed classification, supporting evidence, residual judgments and original rulings; unchanged C/J/O is not reconstructed at each handoff. Consumers check applicability and concrete invalidators; changed evidence revises affected results only, preserving originals and supported surviving claims.

grounding.quote:
Where generic
method qualification applies (EVALUATION §7), its construction result is
frozen before material reference exposure as that clause requires.
Elsewhere this profile stabilises the review subject through an immutable
identity or an equivalent exact-subject relation sufficient for the claimed
assessment. The profile creates no new lifecycle state named `frozen` (P3,
P6; rc.2 #exact-candidate).

constraints.statement: Where generic method qualification applies, freeze the construction result before material reference exposure as EVALUATION §7 requires. Elsewhere use immutable identity or an equivalent exact-subject relation sufficient for the assessment. Review identity cannot move under the review; no new lifecycle state called frozen is created.
constraints.uncertainty: External qualification-freeze applicability is not fully defined in this source.

conditions: The executive configuration is selected.

grounding.quote:
1. attention management: it keeps the exact outcome and basis, the
   Product-role map, the evaluation inventory, the dependency relation, the
   unresolved frontier, the actor envelopes, the current MVP or release
   mandate, the applicable triage policy and the residual boundary, and it
   selects the smallest dependency-ready activation set sufficient for the
   next decision within the finite actor envelopes;
2. evaluation orchestration: it activates capable Workers, Reviewers or
   specialists, keeps their exact subjects and bases, and consumes only
   closed results or declared translations; and
3. authorised action selection: it assigns priority, determines the effect
   on the current promotion boundary, applies an existing disposition, and
   issues only the next already-authorised activation or action.

constraints.statement: Executive has three inseparable duties over one outcome: maintain exact outcome/basis, Product-role map, inventory, dependencies, frontier, actor envelopes, mandate, triage policy and residual boundary while selecting the smallest dependency-ready activation set sufficient for the next decision within finite envelopes; activate capable Workers, Reviewers or specialists with exact subjects/bases and consume only closed results or declared translations; assign priority and boundary effect, apply existing disposition, and issue only the next already-authorised action/activation. It neither contains the complete workspace nor performs every evaluation. Its label grants no Product meaning, implementation, mutation, acceptance, publication or other operation authority; material effects remain with exact operation-grant holders.

conditions: An actor occupies the Executive frame in a selected executive configuration.

grounding.quote:
An actor occupying the Executive frame modifies no candidate, Product or
worktree bytes and performs no implementation effect. Filesystem or tool
access is no exception, and neither is an edit that is small, test-only,
reversible or apparently obvious. Mutation requires a separately activated
Worker or Writer relation carrying the exact operation grant, subject and
write territory. A same-actor role transition is explicit and is recorded in
the existing work carrier before the effect; for that effect the actor is no
longer acting as Executive. Recording or delegating after an Executive edit
cannot authorise the edit retroactively (P6, P3). This prohibition is this
profile's, and it applies wherever the executive configuration is selected
([ACTIVATION §1 Configuration](ACTIVATION.md#configuration), Example; §7);
an operation grant covering a construction, status and checkpoint sequence
does not lift it
([ACTIVATION §1 Roles and delegation](ACTIVATION.md#roles-and-delegation)).

constraints.statement: No candidate, Product or worktree byte mutation or implementation effect is permitted while Executive. Access, smallness, test-only scope, reversibility, obviousness and operation grants covering construction/status/checkpoint sequences are not exceptions. Mutation needs separately activated Worker/Writer with exact operation grant, subject and territory. Same-actor transitions must be explicit and recorded in the existing carrier before the effect, performed outside Executive. Later recording or delegation cannot authorise an earlier Executive edit.

conditions: U contains known material evaluations not closed on the current basis.

grounding.quote:
when no other authorised decision is ready:
    await decision-relevant input (event-driven attention, below)
  record every closed result, technical triage, residual and invalidation condition
  apply only declared conjunctions or translations
  assign priority and boundary effect only under the current Product mandate
  invalidate affected results when the subject or basis changes
  update U from coverage, dependencies, conflicts and discovered materiality

stop only when every mandatory evaluation is closed, or governing authority
has explicitly retained every remaining residual consistently with the claim

constraints.statement: Activate a finite dependency-ready M fitting assigned actors against exact outcome and basis; keep assurance-independent evaluations free of unclosed peer results. When no other authorised decision is ready, await decision-relevant input. Record every closed result, triage, residual and invalidation condition; use only declared conjunctions/translations; assign priority/boundary effect only under the current mandate; invalidate affected results upon subject/basis change; update U using coverage, dependencies, conflicts and discovered materiality. Stop only when every mandatory evaluation is closed or governing authority explicitly retains every remaining residual consistently with the claim. Severity evidence and priority, boundary effect, disposition and next-action decisions remain separate ledger entries even when policy maps them. Recursion follows declared dependencies and bounded refinements, not undifferentiated copies of every frame.
constraints.uncertainty: The source-defined cycle is represented as requirements, not executed or proven to terminate.

exceptions: Unavailable/unreliable notification or a real supervision obligation requires bounded fallback observation.

grounding.quote:
Executive attention is event-driven by default. The Executive re-enters the
attention cycle for a decision-relevant closed result, a material exception
or changed basis, an owner request, or a declared deadline or checkpoint.
While Workers carry out their bounded grants and no other authorised
decision is ready, it waits. It does not repeatedly inspect unfinished work,
replay unchanged judgments or request status without a decision need (P0,
P2; rc.2 #event-driven-executive-attention).

constraints.statement: Event-driven attention is the default. Re-entry follows decision-relevant closed results, material exceptions or basis changes, owner requests, or declared deadlines/checkpoints. While Workers exercise bounded grants and no other authorised decision is ready, wait rather than repeatedly inspect unfinished work, replay unchanged judgments or request purposeless status. Retain frontier, return conditions and valid evidence/judgments; refresh affected support after material observations and revalidate locks before activation/disposition. Waiting waives no workspace verification, evidence validity, independent assessment, closed-result consumption, authority or closure duty. Fallback observation declares purpose, cadence or checkpoint, evidence target and stop/escalation condition. Silence proves neither progress nor failure; unknown status alone does not prove a stall. Investigate real blockers/material risk and intervene where required within grants. Repeated no-progress observations or returns lacking new decision evidence require bounded reassessment of frame, grant, dependency or evidence gap and an existing-authority decision, not endless polling or repeated unchanged-basis repair. Reduced churn permits neither lower assurance nor lower required capability and creates no universal cost, budget or accounting gate.

conditions: Before activation and before disposition.

grounding.quote:
| outcome lock | the selected Goal, Product outcome, boundary and lawful re-entry class, the current MVP or release mandate, and the triage policy are unchanged |
| basis lock | the subject, authority, dependency, configuration, topology, evidence, time and candidate coordinates are exact and current |
| Product-role lock | the mutable Source Project, Product Definition, Release Cut, Product, Install, Artifact and dependent Product identities stay distinct, and every Development Product role stays bound to its exact underlying Install |
| authority lock | the semantic, evaluation, operation, decision, acceptance and publication owners and grants are unchanged |
| coverage-and-return lock | every material evaluation and interaction is closed or an explicit residual, and every consumed result followed its declared return relation |

constraints.statement: Revalidate all five predicates: selected Goal, Product outcome, boundary, lawful re-entry class, MVP/release mandate and triage policy unchanged; subject, authority, dependency, configuration, topology, evidence, time and candidate coordinates exact/current; Source Project, Product Definition, Release Cut, Product, Install, Artifact and dependent Product distinct and every Development Product bound to its exact Install; semantic, evaluation, operation, decision, acceptance and publication owners/grants unchanged; every material evaluation and interaction closed or explicit residual and every consumed result returned through its declared relation.

conditions: A drift lock fails.

grounding.quote:
| changed Product meaning (outcome lock) | `re_enter` to the owning relation ([ACTIVATION §3 Disposition](ACTIVATION.md#disposition)) |
| stale or substituted basis, before activation (basis lock) | the activation refuses: `activation_refusal(basis)`, `invalid_basis` ([REFERENCE_FRAME §5](REFERENCE_FRAME.md#5-method-functions)) |
| stale or substituted basis of an evaluation performed on it | that evaluation's own result is `invalid_basis`, or it is reactivated on the current basis ([RF-005](REFERENCE_FRAME.md#rf-005-exact-basis-and-coordinates)) |
| stale basis of a held result, before disposition | for the disposition's conjunction the component has no applicable closed result: a gap, never relabelled `invalid_basis` and never counted as returned ([FOUNDATIONS §4 Conjunction of results](FOUNDATIONS.md#conjunction-of-results), Stale results) |
| missing material scope | `out_of_frame`: at activation, as [ACTIVATION §3 Admission and activation](ACTIVATION.md#admission-and-activation) states; for an evaluation, on the ground [FOUNDATIONS §4 Results](FOUNDATIONS.md#results) gives, an undeclared material relation or capability |
| missing operation authority (authority lock) | the activation refuses, `activation_refusal(authority)` (REFERENCE_FRAME §5), or the effect is refused |
| an unresolved mandatory conflict (coverage-and-return lock) | the conjunction is not `satisfied`; the conflict survives every join (FOUNDATIONS §4 Conjunction of results, Survival) |

constraints.statement: Apply the owner's outcome, adding none locally: changed Product meaning→re_enter to owner; stale/substituted pre-activation basis→activation_refusal(basis), invalid_basis; an evaluation performed on stale/substituted basis→its own invalid_basis or reactivation on current basis; stale held result before disposition→conjunction gap with no applicable closed result, never relabelled invalid_basis or counted returned; missing material scope→out_of_frame under activation rules or evaluation grounds of undeclared material relation/capability; missing operation authority→activation_refusal(authority) or effect refusal; unresolved mandatory conflict→conjunction not satisfied and conflict survives every join. Executive cannot repair these by enlarging its own frame.

grounding.quote:
Each edge names its source and target roles, its governing
authority and contracts, its lifecycle, its evidence boundary, its refusal
and its invalidation (P3, P6; rc.2 #product-chain-basis; the Product-role
map in the basis is PRODUCT_DEFINITION §7, the lineage objects FOUNDATIONS
§2).

Exact basis does not make a Source Project immutable. A Worker may
cumulatively mutate the exact Source Project and write territory named by
its operation grant. A Reviewer evaluates an exact candidate checkpoint
produced from that workspace. A repair advances the workspace, creates a new
candidate and invalidates the affected results. A released Product, Release
Cut or exact Install stays immutable under its own lifecycle law and imposes
no immutability on the Source Project constructing a successor (P3, P4b).

constraints.statement: Each composition edge names source/target roles, governing authority/contracts, lifecycle, evidence boundary, refusal and invalidation. Directory nesting, shared code/actors, source imports, tool reachability, matching labels or equal outputs create no Product identity, composition edge or authority transfer. A Development Product remains distinct from mutable Source Project and authored Product. Exact basis does not freeze Source Project: authorised Worker mutation may accumulate within its exact subject/territory; review binds an exact checkpoint. Repair creates a new candidate and invalidates affected results. Released Product, Release Cut and exact Install retain their own lifecycle immutability without imposing it on successor construction.

grounding.quote:
Executive, Worker and Reviewer commonly overlap on the selected method
basis, the governed outcome, the workspace checkpoint, the affected relation
set, the candidate, the evidence and the residuals. The overlap collapses
neither evaluation nor authority (P1, P6, RF-008): the Executive evaluates
activation, priority, boundary effect and disposition; the Worker evaluates
and performs bounded construction; the Reviewer evaluates the exact
candidate claim and supplies technical triage where assessment is activated.

constraints.statement: RF-009's structures remain distinct; this section adds or merges none. Shared method basis, outcome, checkpoint, relation set, candidate, evidence or residuals collapse neither evaluation nor authority. Executive evaluates activation/priority/boundary/disposition; Worker evaluates and performs bounded construction; activated Reviewer evaluates exact claims and supplies triage. One engagement frame plus material specialist set, exact subject/basis and capable actor may represent one activated evaluation; the notation requires neither Cartesian-product schema nor universal frame runtime.
constraints.uncertainty: Other RF-009 structures are referenced but not supplied.

conditions: The executive configuration is selected.

grounding.quote:
Where it is selected, every grant, duty, limit and prohibition this
profile places on its frames is in force without exception: the
Executive's prohibition on mutation (§6 No mutation while Executive), its
duties under §6 The three duties, Attention cycle, Event-driven attention
and Drift locks, and the exclusions of the Worker and Reviewer frames (§9,
§10) among them.
Selecting the configuration makes none of them optional, and no operation
grant lifts them (P6).

constraints.statement: All profile grants, duties, limits and prohibitions apply without exception wherever selected; selection and operation grants lift none. Allocation must be explained by fit, resource limits and failure assumptions: actors have finite context/attention, Worker holds one causal cone, Reviewer one exact claim/evidence, and Executive outcome/frontier/closed-result ledger, not evaluator working context. Product basis records concrete capability envelopes; selected execution binding sets time/spend/other limits, declared, measured and honoured under ACTIVATION §6. Fallible self-review stays construction output; required assessment is independent. Staleness requires locks, refused activation returns cause without Worker result, and uncertain effects require reporting/reconciliation. Executive acquires additional decision needs through frame inputs or a further bounded evaluation. Every compact result carries all delivery-material blockers: work residuals/stop basis/effect values, review findings/counterexamples/residuals, and specialist residuals. The subsection is a new explanation, not a default-setting or relaxation of prohibitions.
constraints.uncertainty: Execution-binding resource values and unsupplied frame-input details are not instantiated.

conditions: An Executive evaluation is activated.

grounding.quote:
| result | one core result (FOUNDATIONS §4 Results), the assigned priority and current-boundary effect, and one existing disposition (ACTIVATION §3 Disposition) where the basis is decidable |
| invalidation | a material change of method, authority, outcome, mandate, triage policy, checkpoint, candidate, evidence, finding, capability or topology |

constraints.statement: Executive evaluates authorised bounded outcome/basis, capable frames/actors, exact current returned results, and mandate-based priority/boundary/disposition/action. Subject/basis includes complete method cut, exact Goals/Product/requirements/design/work authority, mandate, workspace/checkpoint, open findings/triage, Product triage policy and any proxy grant. Its manifold includes outcome, mandate, causal cone, inventory, configuration, envelopes, evidence obligations, results/triage, decisions, re-entry owners and authorised continuation boundary. Coordinates bind exact method, project, outcome, mandate, authority, checkpoint, candidate, evidence, finding, triage-policy and actor identities. Governing rules include RF-001–RF-017, ACTIVATION §1 intake/execution, design bounded-frame conservation and applicable identity/carrier/assurance/release law. Evidence is live authority, frame/specialist results, triage, candidate identity, transition evidence and coverage residuals. Capability must cover method, Product, release/MVP, authority, workspace, triage and actor selection; implementation expertise may be delegated. Exclusions include implementation ownership, mutation, silent evidence/severity rewriting, independent-review claims without qualifying activation, semantic reconstruction owned elsewhere and out-of-grant disposition. Output is one core result, priority, boundary effect and one existing disposition where basis is decidable. Material change to method, authority, outcome, mandate, triage policy, checkpoint, candidate, evidence, finding, capability or topology invalidates it.
constraints.uncertainty: Referenced invariant and conservation-law bodies are not supplied.

grounding.quote:
The frame adds no `authorize` or `no_action` disposition. Activation is the
`activate` function of REFERENCE_FRAME §5; candidate disposition stays
exactly `accept`, `local_repair`, `re_enter` or `reject` (ACTIVATION §3,
Disposition). Priority and current-boundary effect are decision
projections, neither core results nor dispositions. If the Executive cannot
rely on a supplied severity or technical assessment, it reactivates a
capable evaluation or keeps the uncertainty; it never silently rewrites the
Reviewer result (P5, P6).

constraints.statement: Candidate dispositions remain exactly accept, local_repair, re_enter and reject; authorize and no_action are not added. Activation remains the external activate function. Priority and current-boundary effect are neither core results nor dispositions. Unreliable severity or technical assessment requires capable re-evaluation or retained uncertainty, never silent rewriting.

conditions: Delivery uses the selected executive configuration.
exceptions: An existing affected thread is extended or revalidated rather than established anew.
An early focused user probe remains appropriate when it decides a material outcome uncertainty.

grounding.quote:
Each passing thread establishes only the relations and
conditions actually exercised; untested branches, interaction combinations,
and refusal and recovery paths keep their material proof obligations.
Settled construction decisions are revisited when material counterevidence
invalidates their basis (P6, P4b).

constraints.statement: Sequence around the early runnable thread and bounded widening, choosing increments by consequential uncertainty, dependency/interface reach and failure impact. Early end-to-end/integration evidence prunes incompatible construction, settles exercised interfaces and concentrates on unresolved obligations, but passing establishes only exercised relations/conditions; untested branches, combinations and refusal/recovery paths retain proof obligations. Material counterevidence reopens settled decisions. During construction use focused deterministic regression, targeted judgment probes and module-law unit evidence. Schedule substantial resource-intensive user-acceptance cycles near release or when a bounded capability is complete enough to qualify. Testing frames retain distinct claims and govern scenarios, independent assessments and repetitions. Reuse qualified results while exact subject/basis stay valid; rerun affected assurance after material invalidation. Sequence selection remains under mandate and construction under existing operation grants.

conditions: A Worker evaluation is lawfully activated.

grounding.quote:
| result | exactly one work-result value, which carries the one core value ACTIVATION §3 maps it to for "a candidate is available" (§5 Work result); each evaluation the Worker performed keeps its own core result (FOUNDATIONS §4 Results) |
| invalidation | a material change of intake, basis, checkpoint, dependency, configuration, capability or topology |

constraints.statement: Worker evaluates construction of the exact authorised outcome through the smallest coherent causal cone, preserving every affected governing relation and disposing competing paths. Basis is sufficient ACTIVATION §1 intake plus accepted design-to-execution basis where applicable. Manifold includes entities, lifecycles, transformations, authorities, capabilities, algorithms, inputs/outputs, dependencies, interaction seams, failure boundaries and proof obligations. Coordinates bind exact activation, source checkpoint, workspace, inputs, dependencies, configuration, actor envelope, outputs, candidate and evidence. All selected method/project relations material to the cone govern; construction/self-review remain ACTIVATION §1's. Evidence includes live implementation, tests and source, analysis, generated artifacts, claimed installed/operational behaviour, reconstruction, mutations and exact transition evidence. Declared competence covers method, domain, implementation, tools, access and finite context. Authority is inherited bounded construction/transformation and self-review only; no admission, publication, independent acceptance, frame-set revision or inferred next action. Exclusions include upstream semantic change, unauthorised cone expansion, self-acceptance, hidden competing paths and advancing after return. Exactly one availability value is returned while each performed evaluation retains its own core result. Material intake, basis, checkpoint, dependency, configuration, capability or topology change invalidates.

grounding.quote:
The Worker label grants no mutation authority. An effectful Worker may
mutate only the exact subject and write territory named by its inherited
construction or transformation grant; missing, ambiguous or out-of-territory
mutation authority refuses the effect (P6).

Read scope follows the complete causal cone and may exceed write territory
within the declared access grant. A narrow mutation grant does not justify
omitting a material producer, consumer or governing owner from inspection.
A repair needed outside the territory is returned to its owner;
understanding a relation grants no cross-boundary effect (P0, P6;
ACTIVATION §1, Execution unit).

constraints.statement: The Worker label gives no mutation authority: only exact inherited grant subject and write territory may be mutated; missing, ambiguous or out-of-territory authority refuses the effect. Read scope follows the complete causal cone within access grants and may exceed write territory; narrow mutation scope excuses no omitted material producer, consumer or governing owner. Outside-territory repair returns to its owner; understanding grants no effect. candidate_ready binds exact candidate and transition evidence and is not accept. Green tests support only relations actually exercised by production and test semantics.

conditions: A Reviewer evaluation is activated.

grounding.quote:
| authority | bounded evaluation only; review access yields no construction, transformation, admission, publication, mutation, decision, disposition or next-activation authority |
| evidence | independently acquired live authority, candidate implementation, tests, artifacts, history, operational evidence, mutations, replay or reconstruction, and reproduced observations material to the claim and the technical triage |
| capability envelope | declared method, domain, implementation, assurance, technical-triage, tool, access, context, counterexample-search and independence competence |
| exclusions | editing the candidate, implementing a repair, assigning priority, disposing the release or MVP boundary, selecting the next action, substituting the Worker's summary, assurance-owned semantic reconstruction, flattening unbound evidence, silent scope expansion |
| result | one core result with findings, counterexamples, evidence-bound technical triage and residuals sufficient for the Executive to assign priority and apply the existing disposition where the basis is decidable |
| invalidation | a material change of candidate, authority, basis, evidence population, severity scale, dependency, configuration, scope or independence |

constraints.statement: Reviewer checks exact claimed subject/basis and applicable method/project relations, including competing authority, proof masking and unevaluated composition, then supported severity/technical implications. Basis includes exact candidate, claim, authority, scope, exclusions, evidence population, Product severity scale, carrier and independence conditions. Manifold covers causal producers/consumers, authority seams, competing paths, claimed failure/recovery/installed/reconstruction surfaces, test/fixture semantics, historical counterexamples and supportable triage. Coordinates bind candidate, source basis, authority revision, configuration, dependency, evidence population, scale, installed subject, review time and Reviewer. RF invariants, execution, independence/traceability, assurance/freeze and applicable Product/design/identity/release law govern. Evidence is independently acquired live authority, implementation, tests, artifacts, history, operational evidence, mutations, replay/reconstruction and reproduced material observations. Capability covers method, domain, implementation, assurance, triage, tools, access, context, counterexample search and independence. Authority is bounded evaluation only, not construction, transformation, admission, publication, mutation, decision, disposition or next activation. Exclusions include repair, priority, boundary disposition, next action, substituted Worker summary, assurance-owned reconstruction, flattened unbound evidence and silent scope expansion. Return one core result with findings, counterexamples, supportable triage and residuals sufficient for bounded Executive decisions where decidable. Material candidate, authority, basis, population, severity scale, dependency, configuration, scope or independence change invalidates.
constraints.uncertainty: External invariants and assurance rules remain unresolved beyond the quoted profile.

grounding.quote:
When independent review is required, and what makes a claimed review
traceable, are
[TICKETS UP-007](TICKETS.md#execution-and-verification-authority-separation-up-007),
with the further boundaries a governing basis adds; what counts as
independent is [EVALUATION §3](EVALUATION.md#3-independent-assessment);
EVALUATION §1, §3 and §7 decide the exact assurance boundary and the
qualification freeze. This profile adds no universal review round and no
new independence test (P6).

constraints.statement: TICKETS UP-007 and further governing-basis boundaries determine required independent review; EVALUATION §3 owns independence and traceability, and §§1,3,7 own assurance/freeze. The profile adds no universal review round, independence test, second verdict or disposition family; ACTIVATION §§1,3 retain assessment/disposition ownership. Activated Reviewer supplies independent live-surface input; coordinated Executive is authorised assessor/proxy applying the existing disposition. Repair-complexity/risk assessment does not make Reviewer repair owner; unsupported cause, blast radius, workaround or risk stays uncertain. When test code, fixtures, mutations, environment or interpretation can change a proof claim, Reviewer evaluates those semantics rather than relying on a passing result. Every finding, retained guard and acceptance predicate binds a violated property, supported entry/state, governing operating/threat model and credible causal path. Excluded threats alone justify no retention; widening a threat model re-enters its owner. Internal location proves no trust and hypothetical hostility no applicability. Retain actual untrusted-input, mutable-state, authority and effect checks required by the supported model. Suggested repair becomes obligation only through its proper owner.

conditions: For every activated family instance.

grounding.quote:
The profile declares the following generic families for Product work. Each
row is an evaluation archetype, not a complete frame declaration
(REFERENCE_FRAME §13). An adopting project binds, for every activated
instance, the exact subject, basis, material manifold, coordinates,
invariants, authority, evidence, exclusions, result algebra, capability
envelope, dependencies and invalidation conditions (P2, P6; rc.2
#derived-generic-specialist-frame-set).

constraints.statement: An archetype is not a complete declaration. Every activated instance binds exact subject, basis, manifold, coordinates, invariants, authority, evidence, exclusions, result algebra, capability envelope, dependencies and invalidation. Material cross-context seams need explicit relations; matching family labels do not establish identity with Product, authority, domain or runtime concepts. Families may overlap without hierarchy: Product has no topological rank over Design; existing Product authority governs meaning. Owner gains no authority over Entity/Operator through breadth; Proof gains no Reviewer, acceptance or disposition authority. Existing authority remains controlling.

conditions: A generic frame is recursively refined.

grounding.quote:
When a generic frame is recursively refined, each child declaration records
its parent contract, purpose, material entities, identity and lifecycle
relations, semantic owners, direct sibling seams, applicable invariants and
prohibited competing paths. Refinement opens only for a material
distinction needed to close the parent evaluation. It is a frame dependency
relation, not an organisational or runtime hierarchy (P2, P4a; ACTIVATION
§4).

constraints.statement: Every child records parent contract, purpose, material entities, identity/lifecycle relations, semantic owners, direct sibling seams, invariants and prohibited competing paths. Open refinement only for material distinctions needed to close parent evaluation. Each material cross-frame seam is mandatory result or required coverage and preserves or lawfully translates exact identity, coordinates/basis, carried value/evidence, lifecycle scope, authority and provenance.
constraints.uncertainty: Translation admissibility is owned by unsupplied REFERENCE_FRAME §6.

conditions: A composite claim consumes material seam coverage or results.

grounding.quote:
A composite with any of these cases is never `satisfied`; it reports the
non-satisfied value that FOUNDATIONS §4, Reported value, gives, with each
gap recorded by kind. Which non-satisfied value it reports where several
are returned is the conjunction rule the adopting project declares (§19
Project-basis additions). This profile's own declared choice is that no
frame is selected as dominant.

constraints.statement: A planned assessment without an applicable closed result—unperformed or only stale/wrong-subject/wrong-basis result—is a gap with no value. A material seam absent from all planned assessments is uncovered coverage, also a valueless gap. Evaluated failure to preserve/lawfully translate yields the seam's falsified or the cause-owned refused-translation outcome/core value. Undecidable evidence yields indeterminate; needed undeclared translation/relation yields out_of_frame; evaluation on stale, advanced, ambiguous or mismatched basis yields its own returned invalid_basis. Any such case prevents composite satisfied. Record gaps by kind; report the non-satisfied value under FOUNDATIONS §4 and the adopting project's declared conjunction for multiple returned values. No dominant frame is selected.
constraints.uncertainty: The project's combination rule and external refused-translation mapping are not supplied.

conditions: The specialist set is adopted.

grounding.quote:
Where this set is adopted, the product testing frames of ASSURANCE §7 supply
claim-congruent evidence to one or more Proof evaluations. Proof is not a
testing hierarchy or an aggregate-green frame: user-acceptance, end-to-end,
integration and unit results keep their distinct claims and coordinates (P6,
P4a; rc.2 #derived-product-testing-frame-set).

constraints.statement: Testing evidence must be claim-congruent; Proof is neither a testing hierarchy nor aggregate-green frame. User-acceptance, end-to-end, integration and unit results retain claims and coordinates. Interface integration and computational whole-path evaluation introduce no thirteenth family, fifth testing type, role or universal activation gate.

conditions: Direct Worker engagement is sufficient.

grounding.quote:
The steps below describe the coordinated branch selected under §3. Direct
Worker engagement keeps the same sufficient intake, work-result algebra,
closure conditions and owner boundaries without inserting an Executive
appointment, or a review that no applicable condition requires (P0, P6;
rc.2 #complete-engagement-transition).
using this profile adds no review, ticket, diagram recreation or owner ceremony to such a task.

constraints.statement: Direct entry is lawful for a sufficient task and retains admission, carrier, recorded result, sufficient intake, territory, obligations, evidence, stop conditions, result consumer, algebra, closure conditions and owner boundaries.
